description: Evaluation test vectors shared by the server (internal/toggles), the Go SDK (sdk/go/toggles) and the TypeScript SDK (sdk/js). Each case gives a ruleset, a toggle, a context and the result every implementation must return. 'hashes' pins the bucketing function: SHA-256 of salt + '.' + value, first four bytes big-endian, modulo 10000.

cases.name: on with no rules serves the fallthrough
rules are in order, first wins
all clauses of a rule must match
equals does not coerce number to text
suffix on a number is false
negate of a missing attribute is true
negate of a different value is true
number comparison needs a number, text is false
semver pre-release is before the release
semver not a version is false
semver two parts is not a version
a prerequisite is itself evaluated for the context
prerequisite not met for the context
a loop of prerequisites is an error and serves the off value
raising to 50% adds the next quarter
raising to 50% leaves the rest out
rollout with no key cannot bucket and serves the off value
rollout with an empty key cannot bucket
rollout by an attribute the context lacks
a whole number buckets as its digits (42 is bucket 2745)
the same number as a float buckets alike
a fraction buckets as its shortest text (1.5 is bucket 1425)
a boolean buckets as true or false (true is bucket 2559)
a rule serves a rollout of strings
a rule's rollout is skipped when the rule does not match
